newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian sugar crush - week to Oct 2.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crushing rate totalled 1.835 million tonnes down from to 1.906 million tonnes the week ended September 25, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.
CANEGROWERS said that for crushing week 17 of the 1996 season average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content rose to 14.74 percent from 14.61 percent the week before.
The latest week brought this year's crush to 25.54 million tonnes, up from 21,59 million tonnes at the same time in 1995.
